code: code = jbig2_decode_generic_mmr(ctx, segment, &params, segment_data + offset, segment->data_length - offset, image);
note: The generic region passes the remaining encoded bytes for MMR decoding as the buffer size.
The MMR decoder reports how many bytes it believes it consumed back to its caller.
When prebuffer refills reach the end of the segment, bytes past the end are not read but the input cursor still advances.
The internal consumed-byte counter increases even for bytes that were skipped from the prebuffer refill.

code: code = jbig2_decode_halftone_mmr(ctx, &rparams, data + consumed_bytes, size - consumed_bytes, GSPLANES[j], &consumed_bytes);
note: The caller subtracts the reported count from the remaining size to decode the next plane.

code: code = jbig2_decode_halftone_mmr(ctx, &rparams, data + consumed_bytes, size - consumed_bytes, GSPLANES[j], &consumed_bytes);
note: Because the reported count can exceed the actual bytes read, this subtraction underflows and the next decode starts from the wrong location.
Subsequent decoding uses the stale/shifted word buffer and continues reading from outside the intended encoded input buffer.
